Game Overview

Swarm Master is a retro title where in Swarm Master, dive into an intense pixel-art bullet hell, battling enemy ships while crafting your ultimate swarm. Strategically gather scraps to deploy varied drones, balancing attack, support, and scavenger functions. Customize your fleet, survive relentless waves, and climb competitive leaderboards to prove you're the ultimate Swarm Master.
